name: research-os
description: Personal research operating system: AI-augmented paper/policy-brief pipeline (clo-author + ARS integrity layer), a two-layer Obsidian knowledge base (personal brain + Claude-maintained thematic wikis), daily/weekly routines, and a spaced-repetition learning layer (engram). Designed to sit above dz-core and be shareable across Dezernat Zukunft.
